backend/main.mo: Backend actor handling user profiles, contact inquiries with admin-gated queries, and editable site content with access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of key frontend components, hooks, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS variables and theming definitions for light/dark mode using OKLCH color values.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point defining metadata, favicon links, and mounting point for the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app routing between home and admin views using normalized hash routing and rendering all homepage sections with site content.
frontend/src/components/admin/SiteConten: Admin form for editing all site content fields, loading initial data, and submitting updates.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Screen shown when unauthorized users attempt admin access, offering login or navigation back home.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button managing authentication state, errors, and query cache resets.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: Renders an about section with a heading, description, feature list, and styled card using icons.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Implements a contact form with validation, inquiry submission, and contact info display.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Displays the homepage hero with heading, subheading, CTAs, metrics, and smooth-scroll navigation.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Shows a grid of service cards with icons, images, descriptions, and a CTA to scroll to contact.
frontend/src/components/site/Footer.tsx: Provides a footer with company info, quick links, service list, social icons, and a contact CTA.
frontend/src/components/site/Header.tsx: Defines a responsive header with navigation links, mobile menu, and smooth-scroll actions.
frontend/src/config/contact.ts: Exports static contact email and phone configuration values.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and auth client configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend inquiry operations with React Query and provides message‑parsing helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useSiteContent.ts: Fetches and updates site content via the backend with defaults and React Query caching.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, theming variables, and animation utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard that checks admin access, displays inquiries, and includes a site content editor.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and session values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom color tokens, typography/container/animation plugins, and extended theme settings for layout, fonts, shadows, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the Legend Techno Solutions site, including branding notes, known issues, existing features, and versioning info.
